title: A map fixing the support of an integer multiplicity current fixes its approximate tangent planes and orientation almost everywhere
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U, O ⊆ ℝ^P open, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), and R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity representation of T in U (IMRep U n with R.Represents T). Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be differentiable at every point of O (DifferentiableOn ℝ f O) with f(y) = y for every y ∈ spt T ∩ O. Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M ∩ O (Hⁿ = μHE[n]): f(x) = x, and ⟨α ∘ ΛⁿDf(x), ξ(x)⟩ = ⟨α, ξ(x)⟩ for every n-covector α. In Lean the last identity reads R.orient x (α.compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) = R.orient x α.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U O : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen U → IsOpen O → R.Represents T → DifferentiableOn ℝ f O → (∀ y ∈ T.support ∩ O, f y = y) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ O)), f x = x ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, R.orient x (α.compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) = R.orient x α
